sub_question: SQ-3: PI3K→NRF2→SLC7A11 transcriptional axis under trastuzumab/HER2 internalization

key_reactions: R-HSA-9761815: AcK-NFE2L2 and ATF4 bind the SLC7A11 gene
slc7a11_nfe2l2_link.conclusion: SLC7A11 is a DIRECT NFE2L2/NRF2 target gene. AcK-NFE2L2 + ATF4 cooperatively bind and activate SLC7A11 transcription. Reactome-confirmed.

key_reactions: R-HSA-9762094: GSK3B phosphorylates p-NFE2L2 (at S335, S338, T)
R-HSA-9762091: NFE2L2 is ubiquitinated by BTRC:SKP1:CUL1:RBX1
nfe2l2_gsk3b_degradation.conclusion: GSK3B phosphorylates NRF2/NFE2L2 → BTRC:CUL1 ubiquitin ligase degrades it. PI3K/AKT inhibits GSK3B → NRF2 accumulates → SLC7A11 rises. Trastuzumab (HER2 downregulation → PI3K/AKT↓) reactivates this degradation pathway.

paradox_resolution.paradox: SLC7A11 is canonically ANTI-ferroptotic (imports cystine → GSH synthesis → inhibits GPX4 ferroptosis). How can SLC7A11-high tumors be ferroptosis-vulnerable?
paradox_resolution.resolution: T-DXd operates via TWO independent components that address different ferroptosis layers: (1) ANTIBODY COMPONENT: trastuzumab → HER2 downregulation → PI3K/AKT↓ → GSK3β reactivated → NRF2 phosphorylated/degraded → SLC7A11 transcription suppressed. This removes cytosolic cystine supply and GSH synthesis capacity. (2) PAYLOAD COMPONENT: DXd → TOP1mt poisoning → mitochondrial lipid peroxidation via VDAC3-HSPB1 axis (PMID 39243601). Mitochondrial ferroptosis BYPASSES cytosolic GPX4/SLC7A11 protection — it operates on mitochondrial membranes, not cytosolic lipids. Result: T-DXd creates a double-hit — the antibody strips away the cytosolic SLC7A11 protection simultaneously with the payload delivering mitochondrial ferroptosis through a route SLC7A11 cannot defend. SLC7A11-high trastuzumab-resistant tumors are enriched for high NRF2 activity (PMID 40464376: epigenetic H3K4me3 + DNA hypomethylation drives SLC7A11 high) — trastuzumab component of T-DXd specifically targets this epigenetic reprogramming via NRF2 reactivation of GSK3β degradation pathway.

complete_mechanistic_chain.step_1: HER2 overexpression → PI3K/AKT constitutive activation → GSK3β inhibited → NRF2 stabilized → SLC7A11 transcription high
complete_mechanistic_chain.step_2: Trastuzumab resistance → epigenetic SLC7A11 upregulation (H3K4me3 + DNA hypomethylation, PMID 40464376) → further SLC7A11 high independent of PI3K-NRF2
complete_mechanistic_chain.step_3: T-DXd administered: trastuzumab component → HER2 internalization/downregulation → PI3K/AKT↓ → GSK3β reactivated → NRF2 phosphorylated → BTRC:CUL1 ubiquitination → NRF2 degraded → SLC7A11 transcription falls (Reactome R-HSA-9762114 + R-HSA-9818027)
complete_mechanistic_chain.step_4: Simultaneously: DXd payload released intracellularly → TOP1mt poisoning → mitochondrial dysfunction → VDAC3 disruption → HSPB1 destabilization → mitochondrial lipid peroxidation → ferroptosis (PMID 39243601)
complete_mechanistic_chain.step_5: Double-hit: GSH synthesis capacity falling (SLC7A11↓) + mitochondrial ferroptosis active → cell death via ferroptosis pathway that cytosolic GPX4 cannot rescue
complete_mechanistic_chain.step_6: SLC7A11-high tumors: the same epigenetic upregulation (H3K4me3) that drove trastuzumab resistance creates dependence on the NRF2-SLC7A11 axis — trastuzumab component specifically dismantles this via GSK3β/NRF2 degradation
